task: Implement canonical encoding and validation for ABI-v10 semantic records.
observation: In ABI-v10, records in every container section must follow strict ascending lexical ordering by record.id. When records were appended in AST or discovery order rather than sorted order, container decoding failed closed with SOURCE_FREE_CONTRACT_INVALID.
impact: Interface emission requires an explicit sorting step by record.id across binary_contract, semantic_contract, and provenance sections before computing section hashes and serializing container lines. Once sorted, record seals and section hashes are fully deterministic.

resolution.summary: Added canonical sorting by record.id to all record containers before encoding and hashing; validated in staging and adversarial suites.
